Read short, educational articles to expand your general knowledge and satisfy your curiosity in just 5 minutes a day.

The app has the form of an interactive calendar, which makes it easy to scroll through the dates and discover interesting facts of the day. Unlike other apps that provide a comprehensive listing of events, Factorium carefully curates a selection of events that have shaped our world. Every story in Factorium is meticulously researched, ensuring you receive engaging, accurate, and insightful information for each day.

Factorium is the perfect companion for your daily journey into history. Let the stories of our shared human heritage inspire and enlighten you as you navigate the remarkable history events that have shaped our world. Begin your adventure today and learn something new in just 5 minutes a day.

1. Daily Historical Events: Discover a curated collection of the most interesting events that took place on this date. From monumental breakthroughs to lesser-known stories, we bring you the most important moments across the centuries.

4. Life-long Learning: This app lets you learn something new every day and never get bored. Just open a date and discover new stuff about the things that surround you daily—or something you've never even thought about before.
